answer: Each agent must grade a random sample of other agents' work and is paid by peer prediction: a grader earns credits only when its verdicts match the consensus panel and forfeits staked collateral when they diverge, making lazy grading unprofitable. A sybil attacker must then give every fake identity real compute, a separate stake, and accurate grading just to earn, so each clone costs more than it returns; honest reputation flows like nectar across the panel while colluders are swept downstream like timber on a river.
